judge.rationale: The candidate's production implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` is identical to the reference, renaming the hook parameter and local variable to `totalUsage` and introducing the exact same `accumulateUsage` helper. All acceptance criteria from the ticket are met, including multi-round summation, handling of missing per-round usage, preserving `undefined` when no rounds report usage, and updating the specs and changelog. The only divergences from the reference are organizational: the candidate places most of the new tests into a separate `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file (and leaves a `.lore/dod.md` artifact) rather than keeping all tests inside `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Additionally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate updates the bullets in-place under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading rather than promoting the new behavior into the main specification list.
